div.div:
Paths
The runner and every cluster call the ALB origin, server.public_url: /api/v1 for the scenarios, /worker/v1 and /state/v1 for workers. Signed object URLs are S3 presigned URLs that Pods fetch from S3 directly.

text.tspan: The runner and every cluster call the ALB origin, server.public_url: /api/v1
for the scenarios, /worker/v1 and /state/v1 for workers. Signed object URLs
are S3 presigned URLs that Pods fetch from S3 directly.

div.div:
Trust anchors and egress
Everyone trusts system roots: the ACM certificate on the lab domain and the S3 endpoint. Each cluster egresses through its own NAT; the tasks reach GHCR and the VCS APIs through the platform VPC egress.

text.tspan: Everyone trusts system roots: the ACM certificate on the lab domain and
the S3 endpoint. Each cluster egresses through its own NAT; the tasks
reach GHCR and the VCS APIs through the platform VPC egress.

div.div:
For
Managed services with no hosts: RDS IAM authentication, KMS KEK and signing keys and S3 presigned URLs exercise the AWS drivers end to end. Fargate pulls the GHCR digest directly.

text.tspan: Managed services with no hosts: RDS IAM authentication, KMS KEK and
signing keys and S3 presigned URLs exercise the AWS drivers end to end.
Fargate pulls the GHCR digest directly.

div.div:
Against
Needs a Route 53 zone for the ACM certificate. ALB, NAT and RDS bill by the hour and RDS takes minutes to create. The server runs remotely, so its coverage needs its own collection.
